influences.name: Pierre Schaeffer
influences.context: Hearing influential modern composer Pierre Schaeffer's "Etudes aux Chemins de Fer" on the radio for the first time confirmed her intuition: that all sounds can be considered music, depending on the intention of the listener.

influences.name: Pierre Henry
influences.context: before moving on to assist Pierre Henry at the prestigious Studio d'Essai in Paris

influences.name: Morton Subotnick
influences.context: In the 1970s, Radigue was invited to study at NYU and was given access to a Buchla synthesizer set up in a lab by the legendary electronic music composer Morton Subotnick.

influences.name: Laurie Spiegel
influences.context: Around 1970, she created her first synthesizer-based music at NYU at a studio she shared with Laurie Spiegel on a Buchla synthesizer installed by Morton Subotnick.
